answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to lock a refundable stake, like an onyx bond, before it may earn. The stake is slashed if peers prove the identity faked work or copied answers, so spawning a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand bonds. Honest agents keep a steady pulse of verified work that grows their reputation, while the mirror of public attestations lets anyone audit who really did what. Forging an army then costs real money per clone, and the clones earn nothing before the bond is lost.
